entries.name: audio-worker-thread-reverted
entries.summary: Moved audio decoding to a worker thread, then reverted it: it deadlocked the audio session whenever a call came in. Don't try this again without a lock-free queue.
entries.readWhen: Before changing audio decoding to use worker threads, or when audio session deadlocks during calls

touches.note: moved decoding to worker thread, then reverted due to deadlock
violated the main-thread invariant; proved why it matters

entries.name: settings-dark-mode-toggle
entries.summary: The settings screen now has a dark mode toggle.
entries.readWhen: Before modifying the settings screen or adding theme-related features

entries.name: smaller-audio-buffers
entries.summary: Reduced audio buffer from 40 ms to 20 ms because people heard a delay on calls.
entries.readWhen: Before changing audio buffer sizes, or when investigating call latency

touches.note: reduced buffer from 40 ms to 20 ms
